A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' was a prominent local broadcast personality on the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] astronomical object [[Wyloff]]. He [[Parent/Legends|fathered]] a [[Human/Legends|Human]] son, [[Ilo Jev/Legends|Ilo Jev]], who would go on to eventually become a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] with the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[External Communications]] division.<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>
